title: What If the Sun Went Out for 8 Minutes?
title_it: E se il Sole si spegnesse per 8 minuti?
idea: At noon the Sun goes out for eight minutes. For eight minutes and twenty seconds nobody on Earth knows, because the last light is still on its way; then at 12:08 PM noon turns to night. Mila, 10, in a schoolyard in Italy: the birds go quiet, the street lamps switch on, she sees the stars at noon, the air cools a few degrees, and the Earth keeps its orbit because gravity never switched off. At 12:16 the light comes back. The riddle: her grandpa, fishing at midnight off New Zealand with the Sun under his horizon, saw it go out too. How? MOON or STARS? (The answer: the Moon went dark, since it only shines with sunlight.)
hook: What if the Sun went out, right now, for eight minutes? For eight minutes and twenty seconds, nobody on Earth would know. Then, at 12:08 PM, noon turns to night.
caption:
What if the Sun went out, right now, for eight minutes? ☀️
For 8 minutes and 20 seconds, nobody would know: the last sunlight is still on its way.
Then noon turns to night. The birds go quiet, the street lamps switch on, and you can see the stars at lunchtime. 🌌

The riddle: Mila's grandpa was fishing at midnight in New Zealand, with the Sun under his horizon. He saw it go out too. How?
Comment MOON or STARS. 🦊🏮
first_comment: Hint: one thing in his midnight sky only shines because the Sun lights it up. 🌙 MOON or STARS? 🦊
